senses.en: The activity of riding a bicycle for transport or exercise.

ex.en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每个星期天早上都沿河骑自行车。

ex.en: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
ex.zh: 投资建设安全的自行车道可以鼓励通勤者选择更健康、污染更少的交通方式。

tip: 表示这项活动时通常不可数；常说go cycling。

senses.en: A sport involving hitting a shuttlecock over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play badminton at the sports centre every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们每周六都在体育中心打羽毛球。

ex.en: Schools can encourage regular exercise by offering accessible activities such as badminton and swimming.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供羽毛球和游泳等易于参与的活动来鼓励学生经常锻炼。

tip: 运动名通常不可数；“打羽毛球”用play badminton。

senses.en: a huge ball of hot gas shining in space
a famous or exceptionally successful performer or other person
to play a leading role or feature someone doing so

ex.en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。

col: a rising star｜冉冉升起的新星
star in a film｜主演电影
tip: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

senses.en: Not difficult and requiring little effort.
Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.

ex.en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。

ex.en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。

col: easy access to｜便于获取或到达……
tip: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。

senses.en: The worldwide network connecting computers and other devices.

ex.en: The internet stopped working halfway through our video call.
ex.zh: 我们视频通话进行到一半时断网了。

ex.en: Reliable internet access enables rural students to use educational resources that may be unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 可靠的互联网接入让农村学生能够使用当地可能缺乏的教育资源。

tip: 通常说 the internet；作定语时不用 the。

senses.en: not the same as someone or something else
used to describe several separate people, things, or types

ex.en: These gloves look similar, but their sizes are different.
ex.zh: 这些手套看起来相似，但尺码不同。

ex.en: Students from different cultural backgrounds can contribute valuable perspectives to classroom discussions about global issues.
ex.zh: 来自不同文化背景的学生能为课堂上的全球议题讨论提供宝贵的视角。

tip: 与……不同常用different from，适合正式写作。

senses.en: regularly moving, doing things, or taking part
currently working or producing an effect
describing a verb whose subject performs the action

ex.en: My grandfather stays active by swimming every morning.
ex.zh: 我祖父每天早晨游泳，保持活力。

ex.en: Schools should encourage an active lifestyle to improve students' physical health and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励积极运动的生活方式，以改善学生的身体健康和整体身心状态。

col: an active lifestyle｜积极运动的生活方式
play an active role｜发挥积极作用
tip: active指积极活动或参与；不等于表示乐观的positive。

senses.en: A competition to see who finishes a course fastest.
A social grouping based on perceived shared ancestry and physical characteristics.
To compete in speed or move very quickly.

ex.en: We watched the boat race from the bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在桥上观看了划船比赛。

ex.en: Schools should ensure that all children receive equal educational opportunities, regardless of their race or family income.
ex.zh: 学校应确保所有儿童都享有平等的教育机会，不论其种族或家庭收入。

tip: race可指竞速比赛或种族；不要与民族混同。

senses.en: not anything; no thing at all
not at all, used to strengthen certain comparisons

ex.en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.
ex.zh: 我打开冰箱，里面却什么也没有。

ex.en: Without affordable public transport, some residents have nothing to rely on except their own cars.
ex.zh: 如果没有价格合理的公共交通，一些居民除了自己的汽车便无可依靠。

tip: nothing本身含否定意义，通常不再与not连用。

senses.en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind
the process of thinking carefully about something
past tense and past participle of think

ex.en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。

ex.en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
ex.zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。

col: give something some thought｜考虑某事
a sudden thought｜突然冒出的念头
food for thought｜引人深思的事物
tip: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: images, feelings, and events experienced while sleeping
something you strongly hope to achieve or experience
to experience dreams while sleeping or imagine something you want

ex.en: Last night, I had a dream about flying over mountains.
ex.zh: 昨晚我做了一个飞越群山的梦。

ex.en: Access to affordable education allows more young people to pursue their dream of entering a skilled profession.
ex.zh: 负担得起的教育让更多年轻人能够追求从事技术性职业的梦想。

col: a dream come true｜梦想成真
tip: dream of/about后接名词或动名词；过去式可用dreamt或dreamed。
